items.title: Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92
items.programNote: Driven by an unrelenting rhythmic energy, Beethoven called this symphony one of his finest works. Its dance-like momentum carries from the opening movement through the celebrated Allegretto.

items.title: Violin Concerto in E minor, Op. 64
items.programNote: Mendelssohn places the solo violin at the heart of the work from its first measure. The concerto is admired for its lyricism, clarity, and seamless dialogue between soloist and orchestra.
